messages: Support check failed: claims 2 (overview – authority to impose penalties), 7 (petitioner position – lack of notice interferes), and 14 (why it matters – proper notice essential) are not fully supported by the cited evidence.
Attribution check failed: claims 2, 7, and 14 attribute statements to individuals (Stewart, Sutter) that are not backed by the provided citations; some citations reference other speakers.

Overstatement check failed: claim 2 overstates the scope of the Secretary of Labor’s penalty authority beyond what Stewart’s testimony provides, and claim 14 overstates that Sutter explicitly said proper notice is essential, which is not directly evidenced.
